description: This Java source file defines the ImageGridFragment class, which manages a grid view of images in an Android app. It handles image loading, caching, dynamic layout adjustments, and user interactions within the fragment.

classes.name: ImageGridFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a grid of images with asynchronous loading and caching, handling layout adjustments and user interactions.

classes.name: ImageAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter for the GridView that manages image views, including placeholder handling and dynamic sizing based on layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up image caching, and prepares the image fetcher.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, sets up the GridView, and configures layout and scroll listeners for dynamic layout adjustments.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes image loading and refreshes the adapter.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses image loading, clears cache, and prepares for fragment pause.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Closes image cache to free resources.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on images, launching a detail activity with transition animations.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions such as clearing the image cache.

methods.name: setItemHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of grid items to ensure square thumbnails.

methods.name: setNumColumns
methods.description: Sets the number of columns in the grid layout.

methods.name: getNumColumns
methods.description: Returns the current number of columns in the grid.
